job.title: Senior Cyber Security Engineer
job.description:
Senior Cyber Security Engineer

Start Date: TBC
£600 per day
Location: TBC | Hybrid Arrangement 

We’re partnering with a growing technology organisation to appoint an experienced Senior Cyber Security Engineer specialising in CyberArk and privileged access management.

This is a senior technical role with responsibility for the design, deployment and ongoing health of security tooling across multiple managed client environments. CyberArk will be your deepest area of expertise, complemented by hands-on experience across the wider modern security stack, including Zscaler, EDR, SIEM and vulnerability management.


The Opportunity
As Senior Cyber Security Engineer, you’ll take ownership of CyberArk and privileged access management solutions throughout their lifecycle—from initial discovery and architecture through to deployment, integration and ongoing optimisation.

You’ll act as the senior escalation point for identity and security-tooling incidents while helping ensure that privileged accounts are properly vaulted, rotated, monitored and protected.

Working closely with cyber operations, SOC, infrastructure and security consulting teams, you’ll also help develop security standards, improve tooling performance and contribute to the continued growth of the organisation’s PAM capability.

Key Responsibilities
You’ll play a central role in strengthening clients’ security environments by:

  • Owning the design, deployment and operation of CyberArk solutions across managed client environments.
  • Managing vaulting, session management, secrets management and privileged threat analytics.
  • Designing PAM onboarding programmes covering discovery, scoping, policy design and rollout.
  • Integrating PAM with Entra ID, conditional access, multifactor authentication and just-in-time access models.
  • Establishing privileged-access standards and providing evidence for client audits, including ISO 27001 and Cyber Essentials Plus.
  • Deploying, configuring and maintaining EDR, SIEM integrations, vulnerability-scanning and email-security solutions.
  • Supporting Zscaler ZIA and ZPA deployments, configuration and policy development.
  • Monitoring the health of the security-tooling estate, including product versions, coverage gaps, tuning quality and integration reliability.
  • Automating deployments and operational processes using PowerShell or Python, APIs and shared automation libraries.
  • Acting as a senior escalation point for identity and security-tooling incidents.
  • Supporting major incident response activities when required.
  • Producing clear technical designs, standards and operational runbooks.
  • Contributing PAM and security-tooling expertise to service reviews and solution-scoping activities.
  • Using AI-assisted workflows to support diagnostics, configuration reviews and technical documentation.

About You
You’ll be an experienced security engineer with deep CyberArk and privileged access management expertise. You’ll be confident owning complex technical solutions and communicating effectively with both technical teams and client stakeholders.

You will also have:

  • At least five years’ experience within security engineering.
  • A minimum of two years’ hands-on experience designing and administering CyberArk PAM Self-Hosted or Privilege Cloud.
  • Expert knowledge of privileged access management and identity and access management.
  • Strong experience with security tooling and EDR platforms.
  • Experience deploying or operating Zscaler ZIA and ZPA.
  • Hands-on experience with at least two of the following: EDR, SIEM, vulnerability management or email security.
  • Advanced knowledge of network security, including firewalls, VPNs and VLANs.
  • Strong vulnerability-management, monitoring and observability experience.
  • Strong PowerShell or Python scripting skills, applied to security-tooling automation and integration.
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP.
  • Experience supporting security operations, incident management and SOC environments.
  • Strong documentation, reporting and stakeholder-communication skills.
  • The ability to work across multiple client environments and manage competing technical priorities.
  • MSP, MSSP or other multi-client environment experience, although this is not essential.
  • Previous exposure to client security audits, which would be advantageous.

Certifications:
You’ll ideally hold:

  • CyberArk Defender certification or equivalent demonstrable hands-on experience.

The following certifications would also be advantageous:

  • CyberArk Sentry.
  • CyberArk Guardian.
  • Zscaler professional-level certification covering ZIA or ZPA.
  • Microsoft SC-300, SC-200 or AZ-500.
  • Relevant EDR vendor certifications.

Why Apply?
This is an excellent opportunity to establish yourself as a recognised specialist within a growing privileged access management practice.

In return, you’ll benefit from:

  • A rate of £600 per day.
  • A senior technical role with ownership of complex CyberArk and PAM solutions.
  • Exposure to varied security environments across multiple clients.
  • A funded professional-certification pathway, including CyberArk and Zscaler development.
  • The opportunity to influence security standards, automation and technical best practices.
  • A potential progression route into cyber operations leadership or solution architecture.
  • The chance to work with a broad modern security stack in a collaborative technical environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

job.title: AI Platform Engineer
job.description:
AI Platform Engineer

5 Contract Roles | Principal, Senior and Mid-Level
£475 per day | IR35 Status TBC
Location: Largely Remote, with Travel to Client Site

We’re partnering with an AI-focused consultancy to appoint five experienced AI Platform Engineers for a major platform programme within a high-traffic, heavily regulated consumer environment.

This is an opportunity to help create the shared foundation behind an organisation’s AI capabilities. You’ll build a scalable platform that product and engineering teams can use by default, with the governance, resilience and cost control required within a regulated business.

Positions are available at Principal, Senior and Mid-Level, with responsibilities and expectations tailored to each level.

The Opportunity

You’ll work across three core areas of the AI platform:

  • Inference control: Developing the gateway and routing layer connecting engineering teams to multiple LLM providers, including resilient failover and load-shedding capabilities.
  • Orchestration and capability lifecycle: Building tools that allow teams to register, discover, manage and reuse AI capabilities and agents.
  • Trust, safety and governance: Embedding access controls, audit trails, guardrails and cost attribution throughout the platform.

At Principal level, you’ll set the platform’s technical direction and lead architecture discussions with senior engineering stakeholders.

At Senior level, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of a significant platform component and establish the standards required to deliver it successfully.

At Mid-Level, you’ll build and release solutions across the platform alongside experienced engineers, contributing reliable production-quality code.

Key Responsibilities

You’ll play an important role in designing, building and delivering the AI platform by:

  • Building and evolving the API gateway and routing layer connecting teams to multiple LLM providers.
  • Developing failover, load-shedding and resilience capabilities for periods of provider degradation.
  • Designing orchestration, registration and discovery tooling for reusable AI capabilities.
  • Establishing API design, versioning and promotion workflows to move capabilities from experimentation into production.
  • Implementing RBAC and OIDC-based access controls.
  • Supporting secure API key issuance, rotation and revocation.
  • Creating caching layers, routing economics and per-team cost attribution.
  • Monitoring platform adoption, latency, performance and inference costs.
  • Embedding auditability, guardrails and safe defaults into the platform from the outset.
  • Applying high standards across testing, observability and technical documentation.
  • Using evaluation frameworks, golden datasets, structured outputs and fallback paths to manage non-deterministic behaviour.
  • Producing architecture decision records, runbooks and API documentation.
  • Supporting knowledge transfer through code reviews, pairing and close collaboration with internal engineering teams.
  • Planning and prioritising your work, managing changing requirements and raising delivery risks early.

About You

We’re looking for hybrid engineers with experience across software engineering, platform infrastructure and AI systems. You’ll bring strong production experience in at least one area, with credible knowledge across the others.

You will also have:

  • Strong production experience using Python or Go to build, operate and troubleshoot live services.
  • Experience running an API gateway at scale, ideally Kong, Envoy or Apigee.
  • Hands-on integration experience across multiple LLM providers, such as Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, OpenAI or comparable platforms.
  • Experience designing routing and failover approaches across multiple AI providers.
  • Strong knowledge of RBAC, OIDC and API key lifecycle management.
  • Practical AWS cloud infrastructure experience.
  • Experience with Terraform, containers, CI/CD and observability.
  • Knowledge of caching strategies, latency management and inference cost optimisation.
  • Familiarity with MCP or comparable service-registry and tool-discovery patterns.
  • Strong testing, documentation and production engineering standards.
  • The ability to communicate technical cost, risk and delivery trade-offs clearly.
  • Confidence working with platform engineers, architects and senior engineering stakeholders.
  • The judgement to challenge an approach constructively and support your position with evidence.
  • Experience becoming productive quickly within unfamiliar systems and organisations.

 

Experience delivering within iGaming, financial services or another highly regulated sector would be advantageous, particularly where auditability, data privacy and compliance controls are essential.

Experience working with high-throughput, latency-sensitive production systems and delivering within contract or consulting environments would also be beneficial.

Relevant AWS, Terraform, Machine Learning or Generative AI certifications are useful, although proven delivery experience is more important.

Why Apply?

This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a major AI platform programme and build production infrastructure that will be used across a large engineering organisation.

In return, you’ll benefit from:

  • A competitive day rate of £475.
  • A largely remote working arrangement.
  • Opportunities available across Principal, Senior and Mid-Level positions.
  • Technically challenging work spanning AI, software engineering and cloud infrastructure.
  • The opportunity to influence how AI capabilities are governed, scaled and adopted within a regulated environment.
  • A collaborative delivery model working closely with experienced engineers and senior stakeholders.

 

The hiring process will include an initial conversation covering rate, availability and notice period, followed by a capability and technical interview focused on the platform programme.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

job.title: Senior AI Engineer
job.description:
Senior AI Engineer

Start Date: ASAP
Contract | £475 per Day
Location: TBC

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of AI and software development, designing and operating advanced large language model solutions and contributing to scalable, production-ready data platforms.

We’re particularly interested in candidates who combine deep AI engineering knowledge with strong production-level software development skills and an understanding of how to integrate, monitor and evaluate AI systems effectively.

You’ll help build the platforms, pipelines and backend capabilities required to deploy AI reliably at scale, combining machine intelligence with human judgement to create practical and transformative solutions.

Why Apply?
This is a fantastic opportunity to make a direct impact within an innovative organisation developing the next generation of AI-enabled technology.

In return, you’ll benefit from:

job.title: Telesales Executive
job.description:
New Business Development Executive Start Date: ASAP

Permanent | £25,000–£28,000 + Uncapped Commission
Location: Milton Keynes | On-site
2–3 Vacancies Available

We’re partnering with a rapidly growing business-services organisation to appoint two to three ambitious New Business Development Executives.

This is an excellent opportunity for resilient, commercially driven individuals who want to build a long-term career in sales. You’ll begin in a telesales-focused position, developing your prospecting, relationship-building and appointment-setting skills before progressing into a field-based role where you’ll run appointments and close your own deals.

With an uncapped commission structure and a clear development route from telesales into field sales, this role rewards consistency, determination and a willingness to learn.

The Opportunity

As New Business Development Executive, you’ll play a central role in generating new business by contacting prospective customers across the UK.

You’ll identify organisations that may be overpaying for their existing services, approaching the end of a long-term contract or ready to review their current arrangements. Through phone-based prospecting and face-to-face canvassing, you’ll build rapport with decision-makers and secure qualified appointments for the wider sales team.

The organisation takes a traditional, phone-first approach to business development, so this role is ideally suited to someone who is confident picking up the phone—or genuinely committed to becoming highly effective at it.

As your confidence and results develop, you’ll progress into a trainee field-sales position, running appointments and closing deals yourself.

Key Responsibilities

You’ll help support the continued growth of the business by:

  • Making outbound cold calls to prospective business customers across the UK.
  • Identifying relevant decision-makers and building rapport quickly.
  • Understanding customers’ current arrangements and identifying suitable commercial opportunities.
  • Booking qualified appointments for the wider sales team.
  • Identifying organisations that may be overpaying or approaching the end of an existing contract.
  • Canvassing local business parks and speaking directly with prospective customers.
  • Distributing promotional materials and generating additional face-to-face leads.
  • Helping prospective customers explore more affordable or suitable alternatives.
  • Maintaining accurate records of calls, conversations, leads and appointments.
  • Following up consistently with prospects and keeping opportunities moving.
  • Working towards daily call and weekly appointment-setting targets.
  • Progressing towards running and closing your own appointments in the field.

Targets and Expectations

You’ll work towards clear and achievable activity targets, including:

  • Approximately 60–100 outbound calls per day.
  • Around five to eight qualified appointments booked each week.

Success in this role will require consistency, resilience and a willingness to develop over time.

About You

You’ll be a motivated and resilient individual who is comfortable speaking with prospective customers and determined to build a successful career in sales.

Previous telesales or business development experience would be helpful, but attitude, confidence and work ethic are equally important.

You will also have:

  • A genuine self-starting attitude and the ability to work independently.
  • Confidence holding conversations over the phone.
  • The ability to build rapport with prospective customers quickly.
  • Resilience when handling rejection or challenging calls.
  • A hard-working and consistent approach.
  • The confidence to approach businesses and generate leads face to face.
  • Strong organisational and follow-up skills.
  • The ability to maintain accurate customer and sales records.
  • A willingness to learn about the organisation’s products and services.
  • Patience and realistic expectations about developing a successful sales career.
  • A genuine ambition to progress from telesales into field sales.
  • A positive, professional and commercially focused attitude.

Career Progression

You’ll begin by developing a detailed understanding of the organisation’s services, target market and sales approach while building confidence on the phone.

As your appointment-setting results improve, you’ll progress into a trainee field-sales position and begin running your own customer meetings. Once field-based, your working pattern will typically involve mornings attending appointments or canvassing, followed by afternoons in the Milton Keynes office.

The organisation views this as an approximately two-year development journey into a fully fledged field-sales career. Those willing to learn, remain consistent and invest time in their development will have a clear route into a well-rewarded and increasingly autonomous position.

Why Apply?

This is a fantastic opportunity to develop a long-term sales career within a supportive and growing organisation.

In return, you’ll benefit from:

  • A basic salary of £25,000–£28,000, depending on experience.
  • Fully uncapped commission of 20% on sales generated.
  • Typical individual deal values ranging from £500 to more than £10,000.
  • A clear progression route from telesales into field sales.
  • Practical training and support from an experienced leadership team.
  • The opportunity to develop appointment-setting, negotiation and closing skills.
  • Greater autonomy as you progress into a field-based role.
  • 25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays.
  • A 3% employer pension contribution.
  • Monday-to-Friday working hours with no weekend shifts.
  • The chance to play an important role in the continued growth of the business.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

job.title: ServiceNow Platform Manager
job.description:
A growing technology business is looking for an experienced ServiceNow Platform Manager to take ownership of a developing platform with plenty of scope to evolve. You’ll shape the roadmap, strengthen governance and make sure ServiceNow delivers real value across the wider organisation.
 
Role Overview:
Location: Denver, Colorado. Hybrid/3-4 days per week in Broomfield, Colorado.
Contract Type: Corp to Corp (C2C)
Candidate Essentials: Must have an active LLC or Corporation to work on a C2C contract
Contract Length: 6 month initial contract with potential to become permanent.
Package: $105–$110 per hour
Industry: Technology

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Take overall ownership of the ServiceNow platform, with roughly 70% of your time focused on platform leadership, governance and delivery oversight
  • Build and manage the ServiceNow roadmap, aligning investment and priorities with changing business requirements
  • Own the backlog and demand process, turning stakeholder requirements into clear priorities and achievable platform improvements
  • Manage the relationship with the external Systems Integrator, reviewing and challenging solution designs, estimates, delivery plans and technical approaches
  • Ensure the business retains strong internal platform knowledge, documentation and governance rather than becoming overly dependent on external partners
  • Oversee releases, testing, upgrades, platform maintenance and change activity across the ServiceNow environment
  • Work directly with stakeholders across IT, Security, Infrastructure, Enterprise Applications and wider business functions to improve processes and platform adoption
  • Continue developing existing ITSM and CSM capabilities while identifying opportunities to expand ServiceNow across the organisation
  • Help improve employee onboarding and other internal workflows through automation and better use of the platform
  • Assess future modules and capabilities, with Integrated Risk Management (IRM) among the next areas being considered
  • Keep approximately 30% of the role technically focused, stepping into administration or configuration where needed while the SI handles the majority of development work
  • Improve reporting, dashboards and KPIs to give leadership greater visibility over platform performance, adoption, demand and delivery
  • Maintain strong controls around integrations, access, data quality, technical debt and platform customisation
Main Skills Needed:
  • 5+ years of ServiceNow experience across platform management, product ownership, administration, business analysis or consulting
  • Experience taking meaningful ownership of a ServiceNow environment, ideally within an enterprise organisation
  • Strong ServiceNow governance and roadmap experience, with the confidence to balance strategic platform decisions with day-to-day delivery
  • Proven experience managing a ServiceNow SI or implementation partner, including the technical understanding to challenge designs, estimates and proposed solutions
  • Strong knowledge of ITSM and CSM, with broader exposure to areas such as CMDB/CSDM, ITOM, ITAM, Service Catalog, workflow automation or Performance Analytics beneficial
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification
  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist certifications across ITSM and CSM
  • Strong understanding of ITIL principles; ITIL Foundation certification would be beneficial
  • Ability to gather business requirements, lead stakeholder conversations and translate competing priorities into a structured platform backlog
  • Comfortable being hands-on when required rather than operating solely at management level
  • IRM experience would be particularly useful as the platform moves into its next phase of development
  • Experience working in enterprise environments preferred, although strong consulting or high-growth/scale-up experience will also be considered
What’s in It for You:
  • 40-hour-per-week contract with the opportunity to make an immediate impact.
  • Ownership of a ServiceNow platform that is still relatively early in its maturity, giving you genuine influence over how it develops
  • A broad remit spanning platform strategy, governance, vendor management, stakeholder engagement and technical oversight
  • The chance to take ServiceNow beyond its current core use cases and support wider adoption across the business
  • Exposure to an evolving roadmap covering areas such as IRM, HR Service Delivery, Security Operations, AI enablement and further workflow automation
  • Potential for contract extension or conversion into a permanent position as the platform roadmap develops

Channel Sales Account Manager

You’ll own a portfolio of reseller partners, create pipeline through the channel and turn strong engagement into recurring revenue.

  • Proactively generate new opportunities through account mapping, partner prospecting, call-out days and targeted activity.
  • Build partner account plans that identify customer opportunities, whitespace and areas for revenue growth.

job.title: Software Developer
job.description:
Software Developer
Permanent | Fully Remote | Competitive Salary DOE

We’re partnering with a growing technology business to appoint an experienced Software Developer to join its engineering team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a practical, experienced engineer who enjoys solving real problems, taking ownership of production systems and building reliable, maintainable software. You’ll be joining a business at an exciting stage of growth, with a strong focus on maintaining a high-quality SaaS platform while continuing to scale its products and integrations.

We’re particularly interested in developers with strong backend experience who value good engineering judgement over adopting new technology simply for the sake of it.

The Opportunity

As Software Developer, you’ll play a key role in designing, developing and maintaining the core SaaS platform alongside the systems and integrations that support it.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll work across backend services, APIs, third-party integrations and production systems. While backend development will be your primary focus, you’ll also be comfortable reading and making changes to modern frontend code when required.

You’ll have genuine ownership and influence over the technology, working through complex engineering problems and helping to ensure the platform remains reliable as the business continues to grow.

Key Responsibilities

You’ll play an important role in the continued development and reliability of the platform by:

  • Designing, developing and maintaining reliable backend services and APIs.
  • Taking ownership of production systems and resolving issues as they arise.
  • Building and maintaining integrations with multiple third-party services.
  • Identifying and resolving issues involving unreliable dependencies, partial failures and other production challenges.
  • Debugging complex problems using logs, symptoms and available system information.
  • Maintaining and improving existing code, including systems originally developed by other engineers.
  • Contributing to modern frontend code when required.
  • Making pragmatic engineering decisions based on reliability, maintainability and business requirements.
  • Supporting the continued development and scalability of the platform.

About You

You’ll be an experienced Software Developer / Software Engineer with strong backend development skills and approximately 4–6 years’ commercial software development experience.

More experienced candidates are also welcome, although this opportunity is particularly suited to someone who has developed their skills within a stable engineering environment and understands what it means to take long-term ownership of systems.

Ideally, you will also have:

  • Strong backend development experience using C#, Go, Java or a similar programming language.
  • Experience designing, building and maintaining APIs.
  • Experience working with and taking ownership of production systems.
  • Experience within cloud-native environments or self-managed infrastructure.
  • Experience working with multiple third-party integrations.
  • An understanding of retries, idempotency, partial failures and reconciliation.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to work effectively from logs, symptoms and limited information to identify underlying issues.
  • Confidence reading and making changes to modern frontend code when required.
  • Experience within a SaaS, platform or scale-up environment, although strong agency or product development experience will also be considered.
  • A track record of maintaining and improving existing systems and seeing projects through over time.

Engineering Mindset

Beyond technical capability, we’re looking for someone with strong engineering judgement and a pragmatic approach to technology.

You’ll be comfortable fixing bugs you didn’t create, improving code you didn’t originally write and taking ownership when problems occur in production.

You’ll understand the trade-offs involved in engineering decisions and prioritise building reliable, maintainable solutions over introducing technology simply because it is new.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys understanding how systems actually work, approaching problems calmly and methodically, and delivering good engineering without relying on buzzwords.

Why Apply?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a growing technology business where engineers have genuine ownership and influence over the technology they build and maintain.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and technically minded professional to play a key role in coordinating security testing activity across a complex enterprise environment.   • Maintaining accurate documentation, reporting, test artefacts and records of key decisions.
  • Providing security testing updates and overviews to executive and C-suite stakeholders.
